2022-23.off_budget_note: Finance Dept stated no off-budget borrowings during 2018-23 (narrow self-report). GST back-to-back loans excluded from state debt by GoI fiat: ₹9,222 cr (2020-21), ₹13,040 cr (2021-22), nil (2022-23).
2022-23.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2023, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 1 of 2024)

2023-24.off_budget_note: Finance Dept stated no off-budget borrowings during 2019-24.
2023-24.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year ended 31 Mar 2024, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 1 of 2025)

2024-25.off_budget_note: SFAR 2024-25 §3.1 names the mechanism: borrowing routed through SPSUs to bypass the XV-FC 3%-of-GSDP Net Borrowing Ceiling; GoI now reduces a state's ceiling by the extent of off-budget borrowing. §3.2: undischarged liabilities (₹70.76 cr unpaid deposit interest, cess/NPS short-transfers). State represented to MoF it has no off-budget liabilities.
2024-25.source: CAG State Finances Audit Report, year 2024-25, Govt of Gujarat (Report No. 2 of 2026)

caveat: Contingent liabilities, not budget spending — a charge on the Consolidated Fund only if a guarantee is invoked. NOT part of the on-budget total. Source: CAG SFAR (ex Finance Accounts Statement 20). RBI 'State Finances' guarantees statement = pending cross-check.
